fusions.name: Planted Lure
fusions.desc: Flicks a lure into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Counted Coins
fusions.desc: A sly kick on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores resistances, and its damage rises 8% per affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Sly Reversal
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Tithe Taken
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying an affliction, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
